label: Copy Optimization
purpose: Refine marketing language so prompts produce tighter hooks, better proof, and more believable conversion copy.

headline_logic: make the promise easy to understand on first read
proof_language: back claims with sensory, practical, or social proof cues
make testimonials and benefit statements feel observed, not invented
cta_rules: use one direct CTA aligned with the offer
keep urgency believable and tied to a real reason
